replacements.Relación entre frontera de evaluación, w: Relationship among evaluation boundary, workflow, trajectory, and outcome
replacements.Diagnostica en la capa del cambio; confi: Diagnose at the layer of change; confirm where the real risk lives
replacements.Diagrama desplazable de fronteras de eva: Scrollable diagram of evaluation boundaries in an AI system
replacements.Fronteras de evaluación desde modelo has: Evaluation boundaries from model to system
replacements.Una hipótesis entra por la izquierda y s: A hypothesis enters from the left and selects the narrowest diagnostic boundary. Inside the system boundary are a workflow, components, model, tools, and environment. A thick path represents one realized trajectory that crosses only some nodes and ends in an outcome and final state. At the bottom, an inward arrow represents diagnosis at narrower boundaries and an outward arrow represents confirming the change at the product boundary.
replacements.τ · trayectoria realizada en este trial: τ · trajectory realized in this trial
replacements.más aislamiento causal · menos cobertura: more causal isolation · less product coverage
replacements.más validez de producto · causa menos ai: more product validity · less isolated cause
replacements.demuestra que la mejora importa al usuar: show that the improvement matters to the user
replacements.Trayectoria = evidencia de una ejecución: Trajectory = evidence of one execution; outcome ≠ trajectory
replacements.si cambias el retriever, empieza dentro: if you change the retriever, start inside its boundary to isolate the mechanism, then move outward to the system. If the system fails, use the outcome and trajectory to move inward until the cause is localized. Do not attribute to the model a result that depends on the workflow, tools, or environment.
replacements.El workflow es una política dentro del s: The workflow is a policy inside the system. A trajectory is one concrete execution of that policy. The outcome is the final state or result that actually matters. The outer boundary represents the end-to-end trial: task and environment are evaluated context and do not thereby become components of the production SUT.
